scope: One non-cutting, user-requested DN900 roof-penetration zone. It is an installation-coordination marker only, not an approved opening, flashing, support or fabrication detail.

change_visualisation.meaning: Display-only warning marker for an unresolved planned roof penetration. It is not physical roof material or a construction-status claim.

planned_location.statement: DN900 roof penetrations are envisaged at approximately X=10000 mm and Y=8000 mm. Mark the zones.
planned_location.note: The supplied position is intentionally retained as approximate. No source measurement or field survey tolerance is claimed.

zones.label: Planned roof penetration zone | DN900 | approximate X10000 Y8000
zones.excluded_detail: No roof cutout, flashing, penetration pipe, support, curb, panel seam, bracket, fastener or clearance allowance is generated.

explicitly_not_inferred: The actual center coordinates, hole diameter, flashing and curb details are not measured or approved by this marker.
The marker does not establish that the DN900 opening stays within one sandwich panel because the global panel-joint phase is unresolved.
Clearance is checked only against the six currently modelled A11/as-1 WVB bars; unmodelled bracing and secondary steel remain unresolved.
